review_rule: Freshly judge Current learner content against canonical Xi Natural Units and Current Chengfeng source. Existing CHAPTER_PROJECTION_COMPLETE state is prior artifact evidence, not the semantic answer key. Preserve the hierarchy-first teaching skeleton when it is good; repair backend content when high-value P0/P1 fixed identities, lists or boundaries were over-compressed. P2 may remain source-primary/deferred and must not be promoted merely for apparent completeness.

summary.common_defect: The hierarchy/role teaching spine was generally strong, but many chapters removed the actual exam-facing fixed structures from backend content together with first-round display density. The result was clear orientation without enough semantic material to support high-discrimination objective questions.
